XIV. Per eam Kabbalae speciem, quae תמורה, Permutatio,
dicitur, de qua vide Hotting. Thesaur. Philol. p. 451. Schic-
k-kard. Bech. Hap. p. 70. vocem בראשית in has duas dividunt: בראשית
ברא שית, creavit fundamentum, (Vid. infr. S. 27.) vel, ut Schic-
kardus l. c. p. 150. addit, ornamentum. Vid. etiam Hotting. l. c.
p. 453. vel, ex Chaldaismo, sex, scilicet dies creationis, aut sex
mundi extrema, summum, imum & quatuor latera. Vid. Menass.
Ben-Isr. l. c. p. 170. Idem Ab. Efr. l. c. tradit: שהם שית אמין כמו שית [?] :
שש הקצוות הנמצאות לכל הגוף Hoc est שית, Sex, ut est in illo:
Ulnae (Dan. 3 v. 1.) sex, quod sint sex extremitates, quae repe-
riuntur in omni corpore. Aliam quoque Schickardus l. c. p. 71.
תמורה habet: בר אשית [?] filium ponam.
XV. Alii per גמטריא, Gematriam, aliam Kabbalae speciem,
literas בראשית in numeros resolvunt, qui sunt 913. ac per alias
ejusdem numeri voces explicant; scilicet בתורה יצר, lege for-
mavit: Hinc inepte Legem causam mundi fuisse instrumen-
talem colligunt. Vid. בעל הטורים Menass. Ben-Isr. l. c. p. 171.

page.notes: Uncertain readings: "seria" (may be "feria"); the Hebrew of the "כמו שית" phrase and of "בר אשית" are doubtful and their order is uncertain; "נכבורי" may be misprinted; the catchword "תריג" is at the right foot and may be incomplete. Small ornamental signs after "העולם" in the Hebrew line were not transcribed. The first line is a fragment continuing from the previous page.
